craft_notes: Sthāyin: the middle (dhāraṇā 38). Sanskrit: ubhayor bhāvayor jñāne dhyātvā madhyaṃ samāśrayet...tattvam prakāśate → L4 keeps resort-then-shine. Rows: row 3 (both-left→shines). Close: forth (prakāśate — shine not made). Rejected: 'equanimity' — killed: middle kept (madhya as LOCATION); 'leaving both' flat — kept both-left as line-2 opener.

lines: Both states, knowing meditated — the middle resort to:
at once, both left — in middle reality shines forth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ubhayor bhāvayor jñāne dhyātvā madhyaṃ samāśrayet | yugapac ca dvayaṃ tyaktvā madhye tattvam prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: Which middle is resorted to? → Leaving both states for the middle, reality shines forth at once.
c1_essence: Both states, knowing: middle — reality shines forth.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
